sections.title: About the Role
blocks: House of Marketers is entering its **next stage of growth**. As the business becomes larger, the challenge is not simply doing more. It is making sure **revenue can grow without cost, headcount, complexity and CEO involvement growing at the same rate.**

The Head of Operations owns the **operating infrastructure** behind the business: the systems, controls, data, accountability structures and operational functions that allow teams to perform at a high level and leadership to **see problems before they become firefighting.**
This is **not an administrative role, and it is not a Delivery role.**

Functional leaders remain accountable for the performance of their areas. The Head of Operations creates the **additional layer of visibility, control and accountability** that makes sure those outcomes are actually being achieved.
The role reports directly to the CEO.

items.title: Make the Business Work Better and More Profitably
blocks: The role looks across the business and **improves how people, workload, costs and processes work together**. It builds **better controls around margin, capacity and resource use**, while also looking ahead at market changes, competitor moves and new opportunities that could improve how the business grows.

list: Margin control and improvement models
Capacity and resource planning
Better use of people and workload
Identifying unnecessary cost and wasted time
Finding recurring problems and fixing the root cause
Looking at competitors, market changes and new business opportunities
Testing different operating models to understand what would produce the best result

items.title: Build Better Technology, Systems and Use of Data
blocks: The role makes **technology useful to the business** rather than adding more tools and complexity. It builds **proprietary systems, connected data and automation** that reduce cost, improve decisions, make the company easier to scale and create more value inside the business itself.

list: Builds internal software and proprietary solutions where it gives us an advantage
Uses open source and white-label technology to reduce cost and dependency on external tools
Connects data across CRM, project management, campaigns and people
Turns company data into useful insights and recommendations
Builds prediction, forecasting and decision models
Builds and improves capacity models
Automates repetitive work where it creates real value
Removes duplicated or unnecessary tools
Manages the people responsible for building and testing these systems

items.title: Make Sure the Right People Own and Manage Things
blocks: The role makes sure **every important area has a clear owner**, the right management structure and proper accountability. Where the business does not yet have the right senior owner, **Operations can temporarily provide that management layer**.

list: Oversees People Operations
Manages and holds the People Ops function accountable
Improves onboarding, performance management and manager accountability
Reviews reporting lines and organisational structure
Identifies gaps where nobody clearly owns something
Makes sure departments understand responsibilities and targets
Temporarily oversees functions such as Social Media until the right senior owner is in place
Manages operational partners and external providers

items.title: Take Operational Work Off the CEO’s Plate
blocks: The role gives the CEO **clear visibility without requiring him to investigate every problem** or chase multiple people. It brings him the important information, recommended action and **only the decisions that genuinely require his involvement**.

list: Builds simple leadership reporting
Creates early warning systems for important risks
Makes sure departments share the information they need
Follows up on cross-functional work
Investigates operational problems and identifies the root cause
Resolves issues at the right level before escalating them
Turns company priorities into clear owners, actions and deadlines
Gives the CEO more time for growth, clients, partnerships and bigger strategic decisions

sections.title: Functions Under Operations
blocks: The Head of Operations oversees and builds the **central operational functions** required as the company scales.

list: People Operations
Technology / Systems Operations
Central Operations / Administration
operational vendors and external specialists
legal / employment coordination
selected functions temporarily sitting under Operations until the appropriate senior owner exists

blocks: This currently includes Social Media until ownership moves under the appropriate senior Marketing function.
The Head of Operations sets expectations for these functions, reviews performance and holds their owners accountable.
**Delegating execution does not remove the Head of Operations’ accountability** for the functions reporting into the role.

sections.title: What Success Looks Like

list: **The business scales more effectively** with stronger use of people, technology, data and resources as the company grows.
**Performance is controlled earlier** with margin, capacity and operational risks visible before they become problems and clear owners accountable for action.
**Better data drives better decisions** across forecasting, hiring, workload, resource allocation and operational planning.
**Technology creates measurable value** through time saved, lower cost, additional capacity, stronger control or better visibility.
**People perform with clearer accountability** through measurable targets, stronger management and faster time to productivity.
**The CEO gets time back** because issues are resolved at the right level and leadership receives clear recommendations instead of raw problems.

blocks: **The company becomes more controlled, more efficient and easier to operate as it grows.**
